ev.q: YPLL increased from 52,044 during 2014–2015 to 88,788 during 2020–2021 (p = 0.002)
The mean age at which OHCA occurred among men decreased from 62.5 to 60.6 years
YPLL per 100,000 adult population per biennial cycle increased from 2,450 during 2014–2015 to 4,136 during 2020–2021
Approximately 14% of OHCAs had an initial shockable rhythm, and 84.7% had a presumed cardiac etiology
The mean age of persons without presumed cardiac etiology decreased from 56.3 years during 2014–2015 to 52.5 years during 2020–2021
The downward trend began before the COVID-19 pandemic (2014–2019).
a total of 22,158 OHCAs were reported to Chicago’s Cardiac Arrest Registry to Enhance Survival (CARES)

methods_quotes.q: Trends in mean age were calculated using linear regression models
p-value corresponding to the t-test for whether slope is significantly different from zero
YPLL was calculated using a standard age of 75 years
For the YPLL rate, the denominator was the adult U.S. Census Bureau population estimate
